<!--
  Selection stability and covariate involvement vs sample size
  (corroboration fragment).

  Purpose. From the realized harm-rule string sg_def already stored in every
  sweep bundle, measure how STOCHASTIC the argmax competition is, per (detector,
  n), at the borderline null theta_dagger(H) = 1.0. Two readouts:

    (1) Rule-distribution stability. Over detected replicates, the distribution of
        the canonicalized realized rule. modal_share (largest rule's frequency)
        near 1 and norm_entropy near 0 mean one region wins almost every trial --
        SEPARATED selection; low modal_share / high norm_entropy mean many regions
        win about equally -- the LOCAL (near-tie) regime the anti-concentration
        argument concerns (Section S4.5). This is the empirical local-vs-separated
        selection signal, per cell.

    (2) Covariate involvement. Share of detected replicates whose rule mentions
        each covariate -- the direct read of the meno-vs-age near-tie of
        Section S6 (Table S6): a persistent split of the second factor between the
        true modifier and its correlate is the eta_n = o(n^{-1/2}) boundary made
        visible.

  Reads ONLY the per-cell bundles list(results, truth, meta) written by
  run_cell() -- sg_def lives in bundle$results, NOT in the pooled coverage grid --
  so this fragment globs the run's results_dir. No forestsearch, no DGM, no
  re-run: it post-processes what the sweep already stored. Defines
  @tbl-mr-stability-h10, @tbl-mr-involvement-h10, @fig-mr-selection-stability-h10.
-->

```{r mr-stability-setup-h10}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(ggplot2)

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || all(is.na(a))) b else a

# ── Which run's bundles to read ──────────────────────────────────────────────
run_tag     <- "m1_h10_knoise0_s1000"           # the sweep run whose bundles to summarize
results_dir <- file.path("mr_sweep", run_tag)    # where <fs|dina|grf>_mr_n*_res.rds live
# results_dir <- "_payloads/"                    # ...or wherever the per-cell bundles were placed
rds_tag      <- "mr"                             # per-cell engine token (matches the sweep)
method_order <- c("consistency", "dina", "grf")  # display order

# ── sg_def parsing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# sg_def is `paste(fs.est$sg.harm, collapse = " & ")`, e.g. "meno == 0 & er <= 8".
# Canonicalize by sorting the &-clauses so "a & b" == "b & a"; a rule's variables
# are the leading identifier token of each clause.
.canon_rule <- function(s) {
  if (is.na(s) || !nzchar(s)) return(NA_character_)
  cl <- trimws(strsplit(s, "&", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]); cl <- cl[nzchar(cl)]
  if (!length(cl)) return(NA_character_)
  paste(sort(cl), collapse = " & ")
}
.rule_vars <- function(s) {
  if (is.na(s) || !nzchar(s)) return(character(0))
  cl <- trimws(strsplit(s, "&", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]); cl <- cl[nzchar(cl)]
  unique(sub("^\\s*([A-Za-z0-9_.]+).*$", "\\1", cl))
}
.norm_entropy <- function(counts) {           # counts = integer vector of rule frequencies
  p <- counts / sum(counts); p <- p[p > 0]
  k <- length(p)
  if (k <= 1L) 0 else as.numeric(-sum(p * log(p)) / log(k))   # 0 = one rule; 1 = uniform
}

bundle_paths <- Sys.glob(file.path(results_dir, sprintf("*_%s_n*_res.rds", rds_tag)))
have_bundles <- length(bundle_paths) > 0L

stab <- NULL; inv <- NULL; inv_wide <- NULL
if (have_bundles) {
  stab_rows <- list(); inv_rows <- list()
  for (p in bundle_paths) {
    b <- tryCatch(readRDS(p), error = function(e) NULL); if (is.null(b)) next
    res <- b$results; meta <- b$meta
    if (is.null(res) || !nrow(res)) next
    rH <- res[res$detected == 1L & !is.na(res$sg_def) & nzchar(res$sg_def), , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(rH)) next
    meth <- meta$subgroup_method %||% NA_character_
    nn   <- meta$n_sample        %||% NA_integer_

    canon <- vapply(rH$sg_def, .canon_rule, character(1)); canon <- canon[!is.na(canon)]
    tab   <- sort(table(canon), decreasing = TRUE)
    stab_rows[[length(stab_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      subgroup_method = meth, n_sample = nn, n_detected = nrow(rH),
      n_distinct = length(tab),
      modal_share = if (length(tab)) as.numeric(tab[1]) / sum(tab) else NA_real_,
      norm_entropy = .norm_entropy(as.integer(tab)),
      modal_rule = if (length(tab)) names(tab)[1] else NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    vars <- lapply(rH$sg_def, .rule_vars)
    for (v in sort(unique(unlist(vars)))) {
      inv_rows[[length(inv_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        subgroup_method = meth, n_sample = nn, covariate = v,
        involvement = mean(vapply(vars, function(z) v %in% z, logical(1))),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
  }
  stab <- if (length(stab_rows)) do.call(rbind, stab_rows) else NULL
  inv  <- if (length(inv_rows))  do.call(rbind, inv_rows)  else NULL

  if (!is.null(stab)) {
    ord <- order(match(stab$subgroup_method, method_order), stab$n_sample)
    stab <- stab[ord, ]; rownames(stab) <- NULL
  }
  if (!is.null(inv)) {
    inv_wide <- stats::reshape(inv, idvar = c("subgroup_method", "n_sample"),
                               timevar = "covariate", direction = "wide")
    names(inv_wide) <- sub("^involvement\\.", "", names(inv_wide))
    covcols <- setdiff(names(inv_wide), c("subgroup_method", "n_sample"))
    for (cc in covcols) inv_wide[[cc]] <- round(inv_wide[[cc]], 3)
    ord <- order(match(inv_wide$subgroup_method, method_order), inv_wide$n_sample)
    inv_wide <- inv_wide[ord, ]; rownames(inv_wide) <- NULL
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-mr-stability-h10
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
if (!is.null(stab)) {
  disp <- stab
  disp$modal_share  <- round(disp$modal_share, 3)
  disp$norm_entropy <- round(disp$norm_entropy, 3)
  knitr::kable(disp[, c("subgroup_method", "n_sample", "n_detected", "n_distinct",
                        "modal_share", "norm_entropy", "modal_rule")],
               row.names = FALSE,
               caption = paste0("Realized-rule stability over detected replicates, per detector and n. ",
                                "modal_share = frequency of the most common rule; ",
                                "norm_entropy \u2208 [0,1] (0 = one rule always wins, separated ",
                                "selection; \u21921 = many rules win about equally, the local ",
                                "near-tie regime)."))
} else {
  cat("No bundles found under results_dir \u2014 render the sweep first, or point results_dir at the bundle folder.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-mr-involvement-h10
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
if (!is.null(inv_wide)) {
  knitr::kable(inv_wide, row.names = FALSE,
               caption = paste0("Covariate involvement: share of detected replicates whose realized ",
                                "harm rule mentions each covariate, per detector and n. A persistent ",
                                "split of the second factor (e.g. meno vs its age proxy) is the ",
                                "eta_n = o(n^{-1/2}) near-tie made visible."))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-mr-selection-stability-h10
#| fig-cap: "Selection stability vs n: modal-rule share (solid) and normalized rule entropy (dashed) over detected replicates, per detector. High modal share / low entropy is separated selection; the reverse is the local near-tie regime the anti-concentration argument concerns."
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
if (!is.null(stab) && nrow(stab)) {
  long <- rbind(
    data.frame(subgroup_method = stab$subgroup_method, n_sample = stab$n_sample,
               metric = "modal share",   value = stab$modal_share,  stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    data.frame(subgroup_method = stab$subgroup_method, n_sample = stab$n_sample,
               metric = "norm. entropy", value = stab$norm_entropy, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  print(
    ggplot(long, aes(n_sample, value, colour = subgroup_method, linetype = metric,
                     group = interaction(subgroup_method, metric))) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + geom_point(size = 2.2) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(stab$n_sample))) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
      labs(x = "Sample size  n", y = "value",
           colour = "Method", linetype = "Metric",
           title = "Realized-rule stability vs n",
           subtitle = "Solid = modal-rule share \u00b7 dashed = normalized rule entropy") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))
} else {
  ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "Pending sweep bundles", colour = "grey50") +
    theme_void()
}
```
